intro: Rewards is not a fourth application. Rewards is a cross-cutting loyalty capability of the GMO ecosystem. It connects customer activity across POS GMO, Arcade / Casino and other GMO applications.

verbs.title: Earn
verbs.text: Points from qualifying activity such as POS transactions.

verbs.title: Engage
verbs.text: POS, Arcade / Casino and other apps create additional engagement.

verbs.title: Connect
verbs.text: The customer relationship spans GMO applications.

sim.title: Try it: a POS purchase
sim.note: Rewards uses the transaction/income as the source event. It never modifies the POS accounting ledger directly.

separate.title: Three concepts that must remain separate

integrations.title: Rewards + POS
integrations.text: A purchase can fan out to Accounting, Receipt, Notifications and Rewards. The customer simply sees: “+50 Rewards Points.”

integrations.title: Rewards + Arcade / Casino
integrations.text: Customers play with separate gaming credits. Gaming engagement can contribute to loyalty while maintaining a clear separation between gaming credits and Rewards points.

integrations.title: Rewards + Notifications
integrations.text: A reward event creates a reason to contact the customer. POS creates the relationship. Rewards creates engagement. Notifications creates the next contact.

integrations.title: Rewards + SmartLoans
integrations.text: They remain separate. Rewards is never a credit score and never replaces lending or KYC decisions.

factory: The Factory perspective: Factory does not simply build a RewardsPage. It understands the complete business chain: POS → Income → earnFromTicket → Rewards → Notifications → Customer Engagement. A single business requirement can span multiple applications, repositories, APIs, database objects, agents and communication channels.
